title: Digital Design Engineer
desc:
PAVO GROUP
, which constantly follows technological developments, strives to be a pioneer by reflecting these developments to its products and services, adds value to itself and its environment, protects the core values with its team, and progresses with the aim of becoming a preferred business partner in the market without compromising its ethical rules, business ethics and honesty; Avionic Systems, Data Center & Infrastructure Solutions, Value-Added Industrial Structures and Information Technologies, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Ethernet Solutions, as a system integrator in the defense and civil sector, offers system solutions to its domestic and foreign strategic partners.
PAVOTEK
designs and manufactures first-class electronic and embedded system solutions to meet the needs of stakeholders. These solutions include IP network communication devices, communication/control systems, power transmission/distribution units, unmanned avionics systems and systems that make energy distribution efficient.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Develop FPGA-based digital system architectures in compliance with company standards.
Take an active role in simulation, testing, and debugging processes to ensure design correctness.
Execute system integration and verification processes for designed hardware.
Prepare comprehensive technical documentation for digital hardware designs throughout the project lifecycle.
Take active responsibility across all phases of hardware development (analysis, design, test, integration).
Provide on-site technical support and failure/root-cause analysis when required.
Maintain and update design files using Git version control and track project tasks via JIRA.
Perform travel-related duties for on-site verification, deployment, or technical meetings as needed.
REQUIREMENTS
BS or MS in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or other related engineering discipline with FPGA emphasis.
Great understanding of Digital Design Fundamentals.
Hands-on experience in Logic Design and Verification.
Verilog/SystemVerilog or VHDL development with industry tools in an FPGA, SoC, or ASIC environment.
Familiarity with AMBA AXI Protocol Specifications.
Familiarity with Xilinx and/or Intel and/or Microchip architecture.
Familiarity with high-speed and low-latency logic design.
Ability to write detailed, clear microarchitecture and verification reports.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Familiarity with TCL Scripting Language.
Experience with project management and environment.
Proficiency in using SVN/Git version control system and project management tools like JIRA.
Good communication skills
PREFERRED/PLUS IF YOU HAVE
Prior experience in Ethernet-based FPGA projects.
Experience in high-speed digital signal processing during the hardware design process.
Advanced knowledge and proficiency in FPGA development tools (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus, etc.).
Hands-on experience working with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR, and USB.
WHAT WE OFFER
Opportunity to experience the defense industry ecosystem,
Friendly and positive work culture,
A business ecosystem where you can take initiative and responsibility,
Opportunity to experience international projects and processes that offer opportunities for development,
One full day of academic leave for master's and doctoral students,
Extended private health insurance policy,
Meal card,
Use of transportation assistance or shuttle service,
Pavo Group
offers the opportunity to work with its team that makes a difference in the field of engineering and new generation technologies in its Istanbul Teknopark office; It provides equal opportunities to all candidates without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, religion, family relations, gender. However, it respects teammates working under variable conditions, process-oriented approaches and is looking for new teammates who can have the same motivation as Pavo Group.
